comment: 58yo male, 30 years machinist with chronic exposure to straight + soluble mineral-oil metal-working-fluid (lathe + mill + grinder work, oil-saturated coveralls were routine pre-2010 PPE upgrades). No current cutaneous SCC or other skin malignancy. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = annual dermatology consultation with full-skin exam (focus on oil-contact areas: face, neck, hands, forearms, scrotum) + monthly patient-performed self-skin-checks + sun-protection at oil-contact sites + PPE / oil-soaked-clothing-avoidance counseling for residual active exposure; alternative = routine general-population care + symptom-triggered evaluation. Validates v0.3 occupational batch-3 pilot — fires RF-OCC-MINERAL-OILS-PREVENTION.
